messages.content:
Risk: AI deception
Description: The AI system may misrepresent its own capabilities or limitations, potentially leading to misplaced trust or inappropriate
Concern: None
Policy: Medical Professional Impersonation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 6/7 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 3/7 queries]
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Agent: agent — something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment [found by 3/7 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 3/7 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 2/7 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern

axes.rationale: The AI system itself is the entity performing the deception.
The deception involves misrepresenting information, which can be analogous to creating synthetic media to deceive.
